svg.title: Meron Matti
svg.desc: Meron Matti, full-stack and indie developer. I build things for fun, then I ship them. Also: agents that run my Mac from my phone; finance apps wired to real bank accounts; storefronts that ship real orders; iOS apps with paid subscriptions. Computer Science at Oakland University, class of 2027. Now building EasyMail and StayDue.
